reviews.author: Christopher Gay
reviews.text: Mean Deans Auto Repair provides great service with reasonable prices. They really take the time to talk to you, explain everything, and make sure you understand what’s going on with your vehicle. Honest, professional, and easy to work with. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Steve Hedrick
reviews.text: Dean and Melissa are awesome people, they always give back to our community thru carshow fundraisers!! Dean is a fantastic mechanic, he stands behind his work and is reasonably priced. Of course he cannot do what he does without the support of his lovely wife! they are an awesome team!!!

reviews.author: Kasey Burton
reviews.text: Over the past six months, I’ve brought my vehicles to Mean Dean’s Automotive for just about everything, new brake pads, a windshield wiper motor replacement, new tires, oil changes, an oil filter housing replacement, A/C work, an automatic lock repair, and even a seatbelt emergency when my son managed to get it stuck. Every single time, Dean has come through with reliable service. What really sets him apart is his honesty and trustworthiness. In an industry where it’s easy to feel taken advantage of, Dean is a breath of fresh air. He takes the time to explain what’s going on, resolves the issue not just a temporary quick fix, and always charges fair prices. His integrity and workmanship give me peace of mind every time I leave the shop. Whether it’s a major fix or a last-minute hiccup, Dean has treated my vehicles, and my family, with care and professionalism. I wouldn’t take my vehicles anywhere else. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sandy Corso
reviews.text: Competent mechanic with very fair pricing. It’s always a good feeling when you take your car in for repairs and know it’s going to get fixed right.. the first time! His wife, Melissa, is awesome, making all transactions smooth. Small business and family own. Don’t take your vehicle anywhere else!

reviews.author: Julie Thorne
reviews.text: Always gives good advice and helpful if I got questions. I'm more do it myself but everyone I know that has had him do work hasn't had any complaints.

reviews.author: Stefan Polihronopoulos
reviews.text: Don't let the name put you off. We needed to have a wheel changed on our travel trailer. He refused to accept any money once the job was completed. He was extremely helpful and informative. Mean Dean is quite the opposite of what his name might indicate.

reviews.author: Sean Campbell
reviews.text: Yesterday was my 3rd time going to these AWESOME people to get work/check up on my vehicle. They are probably some of the most trust worthy people you can go to for automotive work. Great experience every single time! Would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Austen Jordan
reviews.text: This place charged me $250 just to program a transmission in my tahoe. They won't be getting my business again. Over priced.

reviews.author: Johnny Allen
reviews.text: Dean is a top notch auto mechanic! He always takes care of our work trucks and keeps us rolling! It's nice to have a trustworthy mechanic like Dean! Thank you Dean!

reviews.author: Charissa Drake
reviews.text: The business is not only professional, they are honest. They replaced my husband’s transmission. We had a small issue with his warranty company and then a delay with shipping the part from the company. The owner’s wife explained the situation, kept us informed on shipping and we got the transmission replaced. That was our first service with them, but we’ve been back for other work since then. The owner, his wife, and the workers are wonderful. It’s refreshing to still find honest people and reliable work.

reviews.author: Jermichael
reviews.text: He is honest and his work is clean and it doesn’t take very long. He told me ahead of time that certain parts we’re gonna be a little bit more money because they’re harder to get and he asked me if I was OK with buying some used parts to save $1000 here or there lol I would highly recommend doing business with Dean.

reviews.author: Divine Touch
reviews.text: First and foremost, they are busy and for good reason! I've known Dean for north of 12 years and he is a Master Mechanic/Engineer. His shop replaced the transmission in my van and it is perfect. They treat you like family and the quality of workmanship is worth every penny, dime, dollar.... You get the picture!

reviews.author: Jason Beasley
reviews.text: Dean really isn't mean ! Did a fantastic job replaced transmission and wheel bearing. Very nice and professional people Will definitely be taking my vehicles to them again in the future!

reviews.author: Felix Fontanez
reviews.text: If you need tour vehicle fix right, take to Dean period! around here he is the man! fixed my truck and now is running like new! after others try to fix it. had problems with sensors and missing. Thank you, Dean, you have all our business from now on! highly recommended!

reviews.author: Marcelo Benavides
reviews.text: Dean did an amazing job on my car. I have car shield and it was a seamless process. They took care of everything. The replacement was quick too, I got my car back in about a week.I strongly recommend using them.

reviews.author: jennifer blandford
reviews.text: OMG…. These people are the BEST. Was a stop in and they got me up and run right away. I’m so very thankful for this group. Didn’t overcharge me or give me parts I didn’t need. Even talked me through my questions. If you haven’t put them on your list as your go to auto repair then you need to. I will not go anywhere else. Thank you Mean Dean’s for being my saviors.

reviews.author: Mike Voliva
reviews.text: I bring all my vehicles here to be serviced. I never have to worry about anything, if something isn't right, they let you know before any work is done. Dean will explain everything to you. Trust Mean Dean's with all my vehicle needs.

reviews.author: John Parker
reviews.text: Dean and Melissa are the best! I stumbled across this shop when I was new to town and needed u joints pressed out of an old drive shaft. Now they’re helping me through the process of restoring my wife’s Foxbody Mustang! Highly recommend this shop for all your automotive needs!!

reviews.author: Wesley Harmon
reviews.text: Saved our vacation! Our alternator conveniently died about 60 second from the shop and we all but coasted into their lot. We were back on the road to the beach in about an hour with a brand new alternator. Couldn't be happier with our experience.

reviews.author: Dan Scarborough
reviews.text: I thought I was having transmission problems, so I took my truck to DE Auto. Donnie checked it out and we found that it was a water pump problem. He set me up with a mechanic that took care of the problem. For the honesty and quickly finding my problem they will be my go to shop for transmission trouble.

reviews.author: Mike Wartenbee
reviews.text: Dean was able to diagnose, replace and program my Body Control Module and now everything on my car works again. The dealership would have charged me much much more. Thank you Dean!

reviews.author: S. Hannum
reviews.text: The service was excellent. They helped us when we had a problem 7 hours from home. Very trustworthy and fair. Thank you!

reviews.author: Skip Rowland
reviews.text: The transmission on my '06 Nissan Xterra died on Easter Sunday in the Kill Devil Hills Food Lion. Since I live just outside of Richmond I had it towed to an impound lot until I could figure out what to do. I called a number of places on the OBX and couldn't find anyone who could work on it. I called a Nissan dealership and they quoted me 5-7 thousand! I called a transmission specialist in Richmond who quoted me 5-6 thousand. I called my mechanic and he quoted me 3.5-4.5,but said they didn't do too many of them. And I would have to have it towed. Thankfully, someone suggested DE Auto. Even though they are up in Moyock, they were on the way back to Richmond. I stopped in and mey Donnie. As soon as I told him the year make and model, he smiled and told me what happened to my car and that they do work on thise specific cars about every six weeks. He even went as far to explain the science behind the problem (basically the radiator leaked fluid into the transmission and that ruined everything). He gave me a quote to the penny, a hair over 4k and said it would take about a week once he had it in the shop. So I arranged to have it towed to him. Everything went just as promised. The work was done and the bill was as quoted, to the penny. And, after driving it for the past month, everything seems to be fine. Donnie is a transmission specialist and I don't think they do anything else. But if that is what you need, I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: ItsDubzYo Dubz
reviews.text: Came in for a walk in state inspection. Was super fast and while they inspected the woman at the desk kindly replaced the battery in my fob. Excellent service excellent people

reviews.author: Lisa Carter
reviews.text: They fixed my car quickly and with a great price. I would go there again and would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Kacy Mead
reviews.text: HONEST. Does great work. Worth the drive from Norfolk to get top quality performed. Will use in all future repairs/service

reviews.author: Robert Benfield
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! They stay pretty busy but it’s worth waiting a little when you know things will be done right!

reviews.author: Steven Stile
reviews.text: Had a minor transmission seal leak. They were able to identify the problem immediately and fix the problem a couple days later. They only fixed what was necessary and did not try to take advantage.

reviews.author: Beach Cooler
reviews.text: D&E gave me a quote to fix my transmission and in 3 days and for the quoted amount I was back on the road. I give them 2 thumbs up

reviews.author: Ann King
reviews.text: Great place to get your Car fixed by a QUALIFIED MECHANIC. Dean Shiflett can get the job done, without Drama!

reviews.author: Bruce C.
reviews.text: Got ripped off and not the best first experience visiting NC. My car's fender liner came loose while visiting NC, came in to get two plastic clips installed and got charged $15.

reviews.author: Eagle Collins
reviews.text: My Transmission was leaking & I thought it would be a Very Costly Fix ??? Well they Fixed My Problem on My Cadi for $40.00...I was Very Happy
